title: Fruit Into Baskets (Two Varieties)

monster.name: Orchard Ogre
monster.title: Glutton of Two Tree Types
monster.defeatQuote: You restricted the pick to at most 2 distinct fruits perfectly!

description: You are visiting a farm that has a single row of fruit trees represented by an integer array `fruits` where `fruits[i]` is the type of fruit the `i-th` tree produces. You have two baskets, and each basket can only hold a single type of fruit. Return the maximum number of fruits you can pick.
solutionCode:
def totalFruit(fruits: list[int]) -> int:
    from collections import defaultdict
    count = defaultdict(int)
    left = 0
    res = 0
    for right in range(len(fruits)):
        count[fruits[right]] += 1
        while len(count) > 2:
            count[fruits[left]] -= 1
            if count[fruits[left]] == 0:
                del count[fruits[left]]
            left += 1
        res = max(res, right - left + 1)
    return res

python.solutionCode:
def totalFruit(fruits: list[int]) -> int:
    from collections import defaultdict
    count = defaultdict(int)
    left = 0
    res = 0
    for right in range(len(fruits)):
        count[fruits[right]] += 1
        while len(count) > 2:
            count[fruits[left]] -= 1
            if count[fruits[left]] == 0:
                del count[fruits[left]]
            left += 1
        res = max(res, right - left + 1)
    return res
